claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brushes as very soft and good quality for the price.
Several reviewers note a strong chemical or spray paint smell when first opening the package.
Some reviewers report durability problems, such as handles or ferrules coming apart and bristles falling out.
A few reviewers find the smaller eye brushes flimsy or poorly made.
Reviewers appreciate the convenient storage case or pouch, though some find it tacky.
